Change c0435. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. V; 1831 Ch. XXII.

Context before (unchanged): On that night he had determined to consummate his crimes by my death.

1818 text: Well, be it so; a deadly struggle would then assuredly take place, in which if he was victorious, I should be at peace, and his power over me be at an end.

1831 text: Well, be it so; a deadly struggle would then assuredly take place, in which if he were victorious I should be at peace, and his power over me be at an end.

Diff: Well, be it so; a deadly struggle would then assuredly take place, in which if he [-was-] {+were+} victorious [-,-] I should be at peace, and his power over me be at an end.

Context after (unchanged): If he were vanquished, I should be a free man.

result.rationale: Only 'was' becomes 'were' (subjunctive after 'if') and a comma is dropped; the meaning and events are unchanged, a grammatical adjustment of diction and syntax.
